newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka Telecom board reconstituted after NTT sale.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka Telecom board reconstituted after NTT sale.

text.p: The board of Sri Lanka Telecom was reconstituted on Wednesday, a day after a strategic partnership deal with Japan's Nippon Telephone and Telegraphic Corp (NTT) .
Hemasiri Fernando was re-appointed as chairman, while NTT's Hideaki Kamitsuma was appointed as the chief executive officer, the Government Information Department said in a statement.
R.D. Somasiri, A.K. Premadasa, Dr. P.B. Jayasundara and Rohan Jayasundara were other members named to the board.
NTT will nominate three more members while the government of Sri Lanka will appoint one more director to the board in due course, the statement said.
NTT bought a 35 percent stake and management in Sri Lanka Telecom (SLT) on Tuesday for $225 million, making it the biggest single foreign investment in the Indian Ocean island. ($1=58.8 rupees)
